dedupe_keys.name: dam break simulation results for the 10 largest dams in pernambuco brazil hydropol2d

description: This dataset holds hydrodynamic dam-break simulations for the ten largest dams in the Brazilian state of Pernambuco, among them Jucazinho, Tapacurá, Pirapama and Serrinha. Each run applies a breach hydrograph at the dam and routes the flood wave with the local-inertial 2D model HydroPol2D over Copernicus 30 m and LiDAR 5 m terrain, for durations of 1 to 24 hours, and provides maximum and time-varying flood depth rasters, stream shapefiles, hydrographs and stages at selected points and an animation. Researchers at the University of Arizona and the University of São Paulo published it on Mendeley Data in June 2024 as a free download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the ten dams and their downstream valleys. Caveats: the breaches are hypothetical scenarios, not observed events, and results depend on the terrain model used. Simulation uses: downstream exposure and evacuation planning for dam failure in hazard exposure, emergency response and resilience studies. Related records: the worldwide historical dam failures database (data-worldwide-historical-dam-failures-database) and HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras).
